title: Strategist Sim 2: The Troubled Account Audit
brief: You inherited an EdTech ad account in Bengaluru where CPL skyrocketed past ₹350 due to 14 fragmented micro-campaigns, extreme audience overlap, and outdated creatives. Restructure the account with ₹2,000/day over 7 days using consolidated broad targeting and authentic student testimonial UGC to bring CPL down below ₹150 and secure at least 40 high-intent leads!
